result.summary: Found 1 visually broken area: a restaurant listing in the "Popular right now" section has overlapping/misaligned metadata text, making the delivery info hard to read.

issues.description: The delivery-time line under "Tokumaru Ramen Bar" appears duplicated/overlapped, with text crowding into itself instead of displaying cleanly on one line.
issues.suggestion: Fix the spacing and alignment of the restaurant metadata row so the delivery time, fee, and cuisine label render in separate, readable positions without overlap.
